checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face, ears, tail, and hoodie are consistent. The bike fox is a 3/4 view with an open mouth and a slightly different look. The kitchen fox is nearly identical.
Orange hoodie, blue jeans and black paws are visible in all three.

must.item: Bike in park, baking cookies in kitchen, reading under tree
must.why: All three scenes are clear and correct.

must.item: Flat cartoon style and no text
must.why: Bold outlines and flat colours throughout, with some shading. No text visible. The backgrounds are more detailed and gradient-like than the reference.

faults.what: Bike picture: the fox's face has an open mouth and is turned 3/4, so it is less on-model. The legs and the pedaling pose are slightly awkward.
The reading fox has a smaller head and body than the reference. The book is fairly large.
The backgrounds are shaded more than the reference's flat style.

summary: Three consistent, text-free square flat-cartoon pictures of the fox in the requested scenes. The bike picture's fox is slightly off-model, with a 3/4 face and an open mouth.
